summary: First-finish smoke test. Backend fully green across public storefront, auth (login/me/logout), CRUD (categories + products with toggle), lojista settings, order creation (order_number sequence, status='new'), full status flow (new→accepted→preparing→ready→out_for_delivery→delivered), invalid-status 400, and dashboard KPIs. Multi-tenant isolation OK (unauth admin=401, admin endpoints return only owner's lojista_id data). Frontend storefront loads with 17 products, product dialog exposes P/M/G sizes + addons + add-to-cart, floating cart appears, cart sheet + checkout navigation works. Admin login redirects to /admin, KPIs render, sidebar nav-orders reaches /admin/orders. Checkout final submit not asserted via UI because the created order was already advanced to 'delivered' by prior API tests and the page-reload test flow flushed the in-memory cart; however, POST /public/orders was validated via API and reflected in dashboard.
passed: GET /api/public/lojistas/tanahora -> 200, name 'Tá Na Hora', 1 categoria 'Marmitas', 17 products with sizes P/M/G (20/25/30) and 4 addons
POST /api/auth/login owner -> 200, role=owner, lojista_id set, token returned, cookie set
GET /api/auth/me with cookie -> 200 same user; without cookie -> 401
PATCH /api/admin/orders/{id}/status through full flow accepted→preparing→ready→out_for_delivery→delivered -> all 200; invalid status -> 400
GET /api/admin/dashboard -> orders_today=1, sales_today=32.0, pending_orders=1, active_products=17, recent_orders populated
Multi-tenant: /api/admin/products unauth -> 401; authed admin/orders only returns lojista_id=owner's
Frontend /tanahora renders header 'Tá Na Hora', 17 product cards, dialog with 3 size radios
Add-to-cart -> floating-cart-bar visible; cart-checkout-button navigates to /tanahora/checkout
Admin login (santaterezinhaferrovelho@gmail.com) -> redirected to /admin, dashboard KPIs rendered
